capabilities: Apply templates conditionally by heading or target link
Skip or override templates for individual links
Expose note metadata and helper functions to templates
Preview template output in a code block
extras: Templates are managed in plugin settings; a code block previews template output and can save drafts.
intentEvidence: Take your Wikilinks to the eXtreme! by using frontmatter to customize their appearance.
problem: Obsidian wikilinks show only their alias or note name, so link text cannot reflect note properties or context without editing each link.
summary: Template-driven formatter that changes how wikilinks render using linked-note frontmatter and conditional templates.
